mirrordrive.notes:
Release v0.13.8+33

### Features
- Added Google Drive rename detection to avoid uploading modified/renamed files from scratch.
- Added custom ignore pattern manager in Settings to filter sync folders/files line-by-line.
- Added CPU wakelock to keep the phone awake during large background or interactive syncs.
- Implemented Google Drive resumable streaming uploads in constant memory, preventing Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors for large files.
- Run duplicate files deletion in the background with a real-time progress card in the app.

### Bug fixes
- None.

Show the app version and PNSJY branding in Settings
